verified_facts: INSPIRE is a subset of Index Polygons
data is divided by local-authority area
a polygon crossing a local-authority boundary appears in both files
INSPIRE polygons show indicative extent and position
each polygon has a unique Land Registry-INSPIRE ID
the ID relates to a registered title
dedupe requires actual feature identity/provenance rather than geometry guessing
quality_effect: Prevents double counting polygons present in both Barnet/Enfield-style local-authority files.
